integrity: The all-dimensional argument is analytic; finite code checks are corroborative only. The classical average-fidelity identity is credited to prior literature, and originality is limited to the source-specific incompatibility and its no-normalization-rescue proof.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns the standard Haar-average fidelity to a specified unitary target; it does not treat nonunitary targets.
The source's main text and pseudocode already state the correct entanglement-fidelity relation, so the diagnosed error is localized to Appendix B.4.
No claim is made that the manuscript's numerical tables were generated from the erroneous Appendix B.4 formula.
title: Average teleportation fidelity is not a Choi-spectrum invariant
